instruction: Please enable the 'Safe Browsing' protection feature in Chrome to keep me safe from dangerous sites.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to enable Safe Browsing in Chrome settings. The getter reads Chrome Preferences to verify safebrowsing.enabled is true. Similar complexity to Do Not Track setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome Preferences file across all OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux)
Getter appropriately checks for BOTH standard Safe Browsing (safebrowsing.enabled) and Enhanced Safe Browsing (safebrowsing.enhanced) using OR logic - both modes satisfy the instruction requirement
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted to disk before verification
Metric (exact_match) performs correct string comparison between getter result ('true'/'false') and expected value ('true')
Expected value 'true' semantically matches instruction requirement to enable Safe Browsing
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (enable Safe Browsing) which is fully verified
Edge cases handled: getter returns 'false' on errors (file not found, JSON parsing errors), handles different OS-specific paths
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts boolean state as string → metric compares strings → expected value is correct string representation
